description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing application deployment records, including CRUD operations and a specialized endpoint for resolving project names from deployment data. It includes in-memory caching for project name lookups to optimize performance.

methods.name: cacheGet
methods.description: Retrieves a cached project name for a given normalized projectId if the cache entry exists and is not expired.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Stores a project name in the cache with an expiration timestamp based on TTL.

methods.name: extractNormalizedProjectId
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a projectId from various payload shapes, returning null if none found.
